notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Infinity Knights![/h1][p][/p][p]Our commitment to posting regular updates in the lead up to launch continues. While a lot of our major changes will remain a secret until we launch, we still want to post these regularly to let you know we are working on the game behind the scenes.[/p][p][/p][p]Progress has been good and we're continuing to enjoy our journey developing Infinity Knights: Xross. We're excited to share more with you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/3ec55293dcf769f6d610eddd57e0ddcebfb47f52.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Technical Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Updated the entire Woodlands tile set to feature animated tiles and overlays.[/p][/*][*][p]Made further edits to the boundary of the first two areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted animations for second and third players overrides.[/p][/*][*][p]Area zoning now correctly works with animations and event calls.[/p][/*][*][p]Various 'Geo' integrations and implementations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Various dialogue,[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected enemy respawns on area zoning/teleporting,[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon cycling and UI matching,[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow chunking in the Woodlands and Forest,[/p][/*][*][p]Various small environmental graphical fixes. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Thank you[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]As always, we thank you so much for your support - we immensely appreciate it. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Warm regards,

Timesea Studio
Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick
[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings![/h1][p][/p][p]We're very excited to share more news regularly through steam updates and the news feature. We'll be posting more regularly from now on in the lead up to launch! Most of the content shown will be development focused mixed with a small bit of admin.[/p][p][/p][h2]Communication[/h2][p]We have a very dedicated and fantastic community that we've developed on Discord and Kickstarter, and we'd like to start expanding our community to wider audiences. We'll be doing regular small updates on Steam as we progress towards release, so that those who are interested can see what we've been up to. [/p][p]
Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h2]Change in Release Date[/h2][p]As we approach the marked release of our game, we wanted to let everyone know that we will be [b]shifting the release of Infinity Knights: Xross.[/b][/p][p]We like to be very honest, open, and transparent with our community - so here are our reasons for updating our release plan:[/p][list][*][p]We want time to curate the experience and enhance Infinity Knights: Xross as much as possible. Part of that development is the Alpha, Beta, and a couple of mystery items we'll be announcing relatively soon! Fitting these in by December will be quite the stretch, so we're shifting the release to accommodate these events.[/p][/*][*][p]This updated timeframe will allow us to participate in other exciting opportunities that are coming up in the next half a year - but we don't want to spoil anything just yet 😁[/p][/*][/list][p]Giving the best experience possible, whilst also being prepared to patch, update, and develop this game alongside your feedback, is extremely important to us. We really just want to make an excellent game for you all to enjoy, as we value the experiences that video games can bring. Thank you for your continued support and understanding!
[/p][p]We've had an amazing year of development following our successful Kickstarter. As we progress, we're converting new experiences into lessons learned, and moving forward with pace. We're really grateful for the support and encouragement we've been shown over all this time, and we're ready to kick some goals.[/p][p][/p][h2]Updates[/h2][p]In case you haven't seen our socials, we're including some of our latest posts below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/101d6a82901a0ac8d3d8ea6b73f0ac3f11f40291.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/cbd652eb8211b52a6cb8015fe664cec52f12f8ef.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Technical Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Updated much of the tooling for development:[/p][list][*][p]Bulk renaming slices of sprites via regex.[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically creating enemy components, animations, stat blocks from sprite sheets.[/p][/*][*][p]Population of player character animation override controllers.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gathering Nodes have had their respawn rates adjusted, and their materials correctly assign when in interact range (and subsequently out).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted boundary for the entirety of the first two areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound Effect Integration and adjustments/balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Localised assets are fully integrated into the logic flow of conversation, dialogue, and in game text strings. This makes our anticipated localisation of the game much smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted various player combat animations to support new weapon inclusions.[/p][/*][*][p]Cutscene spawn adjustments for single player, multiplayer split-screen, multiplayer single screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Thank you[/h2][p]We'll see you again soon! Thank you as always for tuning in. We really appreciate your patience and encouragement as we continue this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Warm regards,

Timesea Studio
Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 A Thank You for One Year of Infinity Knights: Xross Development 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, fellow knights!
[/p][p]We can't believe it's been one whole year since we announced [i]Infinity Knights: Xros[/i]s and had a successful crowdfunding campaign on Kickstarter. We'd like to take a moment to thank you for your support, so thank you! We really appreciate it. Your comments and encouragement go a long way in helping us create something that we are thoroughly proud of - and to make this game the best that it can be! [/p][p][/p][p]In celebration of yourselves, and this huge development milestone, we're unveiling a handful of brand-new visuals including never-seen-before biomes, dungeons, and combat scenarios in a world we can’t wait for you to dive into and explore with your friends and family. ⚔🌄🗺[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/e1da96bc6b08158a3652c43a72a906beecb6a8b3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/d47c4374d3791001e63e5d088adb145b483f906c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/cbd652eb8211b52a6cb8015fe664cec52f12f8ef.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/814fafc0d676f0fe06948e7fbc15aff81cbc5046.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://infinityknightsxross.com/press/#:~:text=play%20our%20games.-,Video%20and%20Images,-INFINITY%20KNIGHTS%3A%20XROSS"]If you want to see these GIFs (and more) in their full resolution, please check out our press page.[/url]
[/p][p]We also wrote a letter that sums up our gratitude with a simple but sincere 'Thank You', addressed to anyone who has been involved with the project at all. 💌[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/485fb6d03105f118160afc7b1e7439e9c5d2c840.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Thank you so much![/p][p][/p][p]The adventure’s just beginning, and we hope that you'll continue this journey with us here on Steam and by chatting with us on our [url="https://discord.gg/5PCpXtZPaU" style="button"]Discord server[/url] where your feedback helps us shape what’s next as we gear up for the game's closed alpha test and beyond![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With warm regards,[/p][p][/p][p]Timesea Studio,[/p][p]Saxon, Michael, & Tyrone Goodrick[/p]

notes.title: Forgotten Knight Boss Demo (Pre-Alpha)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/40cdfabb199cf7d8a10e63062586c788d72b6925.gif[/img]

In this boss battle demo, we want to provide you with an early hands-on glimpse at the game’s dynamic combat system and allow you to test out a few weapons, character elements, and abilities that you’ll eventually be able to explore on a much deeper level in the final version of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/90319db5163dde256454478c64be17a268db5550.gif[/img]

We do want to preface that this is a pre-alpha build - visual and technical issues are entirely to be expected. It is a very small snippet of what you can expect from the final game. Many more abilities, weapons, mechanics, and systems are at play than what is shown in this demo.

That being said, it's still a great chance to get everyone involved in the Infinity Knights journey which is really what we're looking forward to. Plus, we like celebrating cooperation wherever we can. 

We don’t want to spoil too much, but we're keen for you to challenge the Forgotten Knight during the Couch Co-Op Fest. The demo will run through to the 27th of February.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861103/369dcdcd18835f9e7b092c14e99a3f69fbae8d1c.png[/img]

Also, we absolutely want to hear your feedback after you have had a chance to challenge the Forgotten Knight. You can leave it in the Steam Discussion boards, in our Discord server, or email it to us directly at contact@timeseastudio.com!


Discord is absolutely our preferred place of contact - we've opened up a forum inside of Discord for all Forgotten Knight related posts.


[h1]Our Eternal Gratitude[/h1]

Please stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being part of our adventure! We are so appreciative of you all every day.

Warm regards,

Timesea Studio
Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick

notes.title: Indie RPG Magic: Support our Retro Co-Op on Kickstarter!”
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're live on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinityknightsxross/infinity-knights-xross?ref=5qxseg


This is a chance for our fans to get involved with the game. Whether it's to secure a copy of the game early or to be part of the development and community, that's up to you. We have a range of rewards on offer, from having your own customised objects/fish/statues in the game to creating your very own playable character (yes, that's right!).

Most importantly, as the funding increases, so too will the scope of Infinity Knights: Xross. The size of the game at release will dictate the final price. 

[b]By backing us now, you’ll not only get the most affordable option, but you’ll also be directly contributing to the development of the game.[/b]

By putting your money into this Kickstarter, you aren’t just buying a game. You are enabling us to create more environments, characters, enemies, you name it! In addition, the opportunity to design NPCs and Bosses, take part in feedback, testing, and early access, have commemorative statues, plaques, and credit in your name… all of this is exclusive to Kickstarter.

Thank you for your time and consideration, and we hope to speak to you soon. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Our Trailer is live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8kHkGcRgKwo;full][/previewyoutube]

We're proud to announce that our Kickstarter is going live on JUNE 25th! And along with it, we have a trailer featuring gameplay clips from Infinity Knights: Xross. 

You'll be listening to Hiroki Kikuta's 'Going to the Eternal', a track made especially for this game that explores the freedom and struggles behind becoming immortal.

Always welcome to message us through the Steam boards, Discord, or even email us! We try to respond to everyone :) [b]Thank you for your time and consideration - it means the world to us.[/b]

We recently had an exclusive article written about us and the game on Nintendo Life. It goes a little further in-depth than we have ever gone on socials, so be sure to check it out. It has information on combat, some story, some core concepts behind the game, and what it's been like working with Hiroki Kikuta: https://www.nintendolife.com/features/exclusive-meet-the-three-brothers-making-their-dream-secret-of-mana-inspired-rpg


You can also subscribe to updates on the game through our website, although we will post the major announcements on Kickstarter, Steam, and our Discord. If you want to receive emails from us, you can subscribe at: https://infinityknightsxross.com/lp


Please join us on Steam, Kickstarter, and socials, while we continue to create our dream game!
